title: Combined automation management and run history
description: Exercise the combined automation definitions and global run history surface, disabled-save path, schedule/timezone controls, concurrency setting, and owner-safe cleanup.

steps.expected: One accessible Automations button with a visible Clock3 icon, no Run history navigation button, and the unchanged Blocks icon for Manage Google Workspace.
Automations reuse an existing backend-owned shared-storage bucket
Use keyboard to open More workspace actions. Exactly one Automations menu item shows Clock3; Manage Google Workspace shows Blocks; no Run history menu item. Leave the menu open for its screenshot.
Focus Automations in the More menu and press Enter. The combined definition and Run history screen opens and the menu closes.
Return to desktop and confirm the combined Automations surface is open.

steps.label: Instructions
steps.value: Write one unique fixture file; do not publish or send external messages.

steps.expected: Wait for exactly five occurrences and no Checking schedule text. Record schedule-preview request count, edit Name and Instructions, and wait at least 11000ms (two five-second polling intervals), including two history refreshes. Occurrences remain and no preview request is added. Burst-edit cron/timezone within 350ms; only the final pair adds one successful request and five new occurrences. Capture the endpoint counts and statuses, without auth headers.

With the tall editor open, wheel/trackpad and keyboard Tab can reach Recovery, Create automation, Cancel, Run history, and its bottom controls. On desktop only the automation page scrolls and topbar stays fixed; at widths <=900px the document scrolls continuously (also verify touch at 390px). No page-wide horizontal overflow. Capture the top and bottom at 1280x720 and 390x844.
Cancel the draft, Back to workspace, and verify the main Agent/terminal sizing and scroll ownership are unchanged. Reopen Automations and recreate the same draft; restore 1280x720 before continuing.
